_comment: Every input of build-sqlcipher3.yml, pinned by content hash. The workflow reads its versions from here and fails on any mismatch; nothing is fetched by name alone. RULINGS 248 (Brad 2026-11-11 21:24).

binding.name: sqlcipher3-wheels
binding._note: Only the binding's C sources (src/*.c, src/*.h) and its sqlcipher3/ package are used. Its setup.py (which runs conan install with -b missing) and its bundled SQLite 3.51.1 / SQLCipher 4.12.0 amalgamation are replaced.

sqlcipher._note: Zetetic's tags and commits are not signed (GitHub API: verification.reason=unsigned), so the commit sha is the pin. The amalgamation is generated with the tree's own configure (autosetup, its bundled jimsh; no tclsh) and is byte-identical across runs (measured twice on Linux, 2026-11-11), so its hashes are pinned too.

nasm._note: Windows only: OpenSSL's AES-NI and SHA code is perlasm that NASM assembles, and no-asm would leave table AES (a cache-timing side channel). nasm.us publishes no signature or checksum for this zip and no second origin carries it, so this hash is TRUST ON FIRST USE (downloaded 2026-11-11).

openssl._note: The fingerprint is the one openssl-library.org/source/ names for current releases, and keys.openpgp.org serves the same certificate (checked 2026-11-11). Its signing subkey C46ED3F2CBEFDA1FDAADA44264ED7B1DCCE71CB2 expires 2027-05-26. The tarball's signature is verified against this fingerprint before anything is built, with no fallback.
openssl._why_options: Static, so the wheel carries exactly this OpenSSL. no-dso and no-module: the library cannot load code from a file at run time. no-autoload-config: it never reads an openssl.cnf, so a config planted in OPENSSLDIR (the CVE-2019-1552 class on Windows) cannot load a provider into the node. no-legacy: SQLCipher uses AES-256-CBC, HMAC-SHA1/256/512, PBKDF2 and the RNG only.
